title: Major disaster declared: Tropical Storm Gordon Tornadoes Flooding Rainfall, Florida (DR-1043)
summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for Florida (severe storm), declared 1994-11-28.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (1,458 affected)
summary: THE HOLE IN THE BOLT PORTION OF THE VANDALOCK WAS DRILLED IN AN INCORRECT LOCATION, ALLOWING THE PIN TO BE INSERTED WITH THE BOLT IN THE LOCKED POSITION WHILE BYPASSING THE STARTER INTERLOCK. THIS CAN RESULT IN THE ENGINE STARTING SYSTEM OPERATING WHILE THE EMERGENCY EXIT DOOR IS LOCKED. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RELEASE AND RETENTION."

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER (132 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER'S SIDE AIR BAG MODULE MAY NOT PROPERLY DEPLOY.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:BRACKET:SUPPORT:CENTER SHAFT (17,720 affected)
summary: THE DRIVESHAFT CENTER BEARING SUPPORT BRACKET CAN CRACK AND BREAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (72,000 affected)
summary: THE WIRING HARNESS INSULATION CAN ABRADE ON A BRACE THAT RUNS FROM THE INSTRUMENT PANEL TO THE COWL.

title: Ford Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER (112,000 affected)
summary: THE ALTERNATOR OUTPUT WIRE WAS NOT CONNECTED TIGHTLY TO THE POWER DISTRIBUTION BOX.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY:LINKAGE:RIGID (20,518 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE PARK LOCK CABLE ASSEMBLY WAS IMPROPERLY ADJUSTED MAKING IT POSSIBLE TO SHIFT FROM THE "PARK" POSITION WITH THE IGNITION KEY REMOVED, OR REMOVE THE IGNITION KEY WITH THE SHIFT LEVER IN A POSITION OTHER THAN "PARK." THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 114, "THEFT PROTECTION."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (2,180 affected)
summary: THE DOUBLE-LOCK FEATURE CAN ENGAGE WITH OCCUPANTS AND THE DOOR/IGNITION KEY INSIDE THE VEHICLE.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (16,497 affected)
summary: AN UNUSED HARNESS CONNECTOR FOR POWER WINDOWS, POWER DOOR LOCKS AND SUNROOF WAS IMPROPERLY ROUTED UNDER THE FLOOR CARPET IN THE LEFT KICK PANEL. IF THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN COLD WEATHER CONDITIONS WHERE LARGE AMOUNTS OF ROAD SALTS ARE USED, THE SALT WATER OR SNOW CARRIED INTO THE VEHICLE BY THE DRIVER'S SHOES CAN PENETRATE THE CARPET AND DRIP ONTO THE CONNECTOR RESULTING IN THE FORMATION OF A SALT BRIDGE BETWEEN THE TERMINALS.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS: (1,690 affected)
summary: THE ALUMINUM REAR SPRING SHACKLE BRACKETS HAVE DEVELOPED CRACKS WHICH CAN LEAD TO SEPARATION OF THE BRACKETS FROM THE FRAME RAIL.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER (240 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER SIDE AIR BAG MODULE CAN HAVE AN INADEQUATELY WELDED INFLATOR CANISTER.

title: WIX CORPORATION: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS (1,724 affected)
summary: THE GASOLINE FILTERS CANNOT BE SCREWED IN MORE THAN ONE TO ONE AND A HALF TURNS CAUSING THE FILTER NOT TO SEAL PROPERLY WITH THE FUEL LINE.

title: FISHER-PRICE, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (11,020 affected)
summary: THE SEATS HAVE AN INCORRECTLY POSITIONED LABEL WARNING THAT ANY CAR SEAT USED IN THE REAR-FACING POSITION SHOULD NOT BE INSTALLED IN AN AUTOMOBILE SEAT ON WHICH AN AIR BAG MAY DEPLOY. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."

title: TRANSI-CORP.: STRUCTURE:FRAME AND MEMBERS(GIVE SIDE/END) (51 affected)
summary: CRACKING OF THE CHASSIS FRAME RAIL OCCURS ABOVE THE FRONT AXLE'S FRONT AND REAR SPRING HANGERS.

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BUCKET:BACK REST (10,584 affected)
summary: ONE OR MORE OF THE ARC WELDS CAN BE MISSING ON THE SEAT BACK FRAME RECLINER.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS (185 affected)
summary: BOTH THE SUPPLEMENTAL INFLATABLE RESTRAINT (SIR) CAUTION LABEL AND AN ENGINE START LABEL WERE INSTALLED ON THE SAME SIDE OF THE DRIVER'S SUN VISOR. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:CHECK VALVE (30,263 affected)
summary: A VACUUM HOSE CAN DETACH FROM THE POWER BRAKE BOOSTER CHECK VALVE AS A RESULT OF ENGINE BACKFIRE.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:PARK LIGHTS (1,022 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT FRONT PARK/TURN SIGNAL BULB WHICH DOES NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT CANDLE POWER. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER:BAL (221 affected)
summary: A RIGHT-HAND LOWER CONTROL ARM TAPERED BALL JOINT MOUNTING HOLE WAS INCORRECTLY MACHINED. MOVEMENT WITHIN THIS ATTACHMENT CAN ALLOW THE BALL JOINT STUD TO FATIGUE AND FRACTURE.

title: Gillig, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (590 affected)
summary: THE SHOULDER HARNESS ANCHOR FASTENERS USED ON THESE BUSES FOR WHEEL CHAIR POSITIONS WERE INSTALLED WITH INCORRECT HARDWARE.   THE ANCHOR FASTENERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: SUSPENSION:MOTORCYCLE REAR SWING ARM PIVOT SHAFT (5,530 affected)
summary: THE REAR SWING-ARM WELDS CAN BREAK, ALLOWING ONE OR BOTH OF THE SWING-ARM BEAMS TO SEPARATE FROM THE MAIN CASTING.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:AIR:LINES AND FITTINGS (71 affected)
summary: AT LOW AMBIENT TEMPERATURE, WITH THE PARKING BRAKE APPLIED ABD THE ENGINE RUNNING, PRESSURE CAN BUILD UP SUFFICIENTLY TO PARTIALLY PRESSURIZE THE BRAKE CHAMBER WHICH CONTROLS THE DDM PARK BRAKE AT THE REAR OF THE TRANSMISSION ALLOWING THE PARKING BRAKE TO PARTIALLY RELEASE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: STEERING:YOKE (MOTORCYCLE) (2,000 affected)
summary: THE ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBARS CAN CRACK.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: SUSPENSION:MOTORCYCLE FRONT (2,000 affected)
summary: THE NUT THAT SECURES THE FRONT FORK LOWER BRIDGE BALL JOINT TO THE TELELEVER SUSPENSION ARM CAN LOOSEN.

title: MONROE AUTO CORP.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER (98,000 affected)
summary: THE ARC WELDS ON THE SWAY BAR BRACKET, WHERE IT ATTACHES TO THE STRUT RESERVE TUBE, DID NOT FUSE PROPERLY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: BRAKES:POWER ASSIST:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (62 affected)
summary: THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM ON THESE BUSES USES TWO HYDRAULIC PRESSURE SWITCHES TO OPERATE THE BRAKE LIGHTS AND THE BRAKE BOOSTER PUMP. THE BRAKE PRESSURE WARNING LIGHT CAN ACTIVATE WHEN ACTUAL SYSTEM FAILURE HAS NOT OCCURRED.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID CONTROL MODE SOLENOID S (3 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITHOUT SEPARATE ABS INDICATOR LAMPS. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: CROWN COACH CORPORATION: STRUCTURE:BODY (872 affected)
summary: FLOOR DETERIORATION DUE TO WATER SEEPAGE.
